name: com.gameframex.unity.operationkeyboard.fairygui
displayName: Game Frame X Operation Keyboard (FairyGUI Binding)
description:
FairyGUI GTextInput keyboard binder plus a bootstrap auto-binder for GameFrameX OperationKeyboard. Zero panel changes: OperationKeyboardFairyGUIAutoBinder polls Stage.inst.focus and attaches the matching binder; com.gameframex.unity.fairygui.unity presence is probed via versionDefines (presence implies enabled; binder code is stripped when the package is absent and the native keyboard path is fully preserved).

GameFrameX OperationKeyboard 的 FairyGUI GTextInput 键盘绑定包，含自举自动挂载器。零面板改动：OperationKeyboardFairyGUIAutoBinder 低频轮询 Stage 焦点并挂载绑定器；com.gameframex.unity.fairygui.unity 是否安装经 versionDefines 探测（发现即挂载，未安装时绑定器代码被裁剪，原生键盘路径完整保留）。
